name: Restaurant Lead Generation API
description: Find restaurants that need marketing, review management, SEO, websites, online ordering, or operational help — then score, enrich, and prepare outreach. Agent-native pipeline for autonomous sales, marketing, and local-business agents that build qualified restaurant pipeline on every call.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Build a list of 25 under-marketed Italian restaurants in Austin and rank them by likelihood to buy review-management services.
Enrich a shortlist of restaurant leads with owner contact data and tech stack before an outreach campaign.
Generate a tailored, pain-point-grounded outreach email for each qualified lead.
Export a qualified lead set directly into a HubSpot-ready CRM payload.

agentUseCases.workflow: Call /run-lead-pipeline nightly per territory, then queue /contact-lead for human approval each morning.
Find leads, attach a Growth Opportunity audit via chain_to, and pitch the highest missed-revenue accounts first.
Score inbound restaurant prospects and route best_offer_type to the right service line.

human_approval_required.reason: Outbound contact to a real business is an irreversible, outward-facing action requiring explicit human approval token.

chain_to.reason: Quantify the revenue gap to strengthen the pitch.
Produce a deliverable audit to attach to outreach.
Back the review-pain angle with hard data.

recommended_actions_priority_order.action: Run /run-lead-pipeline for the target territory and ICP.
Review qualified_leads sorted by lead_score; enrich any missing top-N.
Generate or refine outreach angle per lead.
Submit /contact-lead for human approval before any send.

examplePrompts: Find me 25 Italian restaurants in Austin that need review management and rank them.
Enrich the top 5 leads with owner contact info and draft a consultative outreach email each.
Export my qualified Austin restaurant leads as a HubSpot payload.
Which of these leads has the highest likelihood to buy online-ordering setup?
